overclaims: The decisive evidence comes from one research team, which also sells AI security products.
checks.note: The excerpt is verbatim. The proposition is faithful, and the LLM scope and snapshot caveats are shown. The rationale is supported: 15 models from 5 developers (4 besides Anthropic) all had non-trivial multi-turn ASR, ranging from 7.89% to 88.30%. The outcome, axis and horizon match the reviews, and the e1 citation is accurate. One limitation says Cisco 'also sells AI security products'. The evidence names Cisco's security framework taxonomy but never says Cisco sells AI security products. That sentence is unsupported and hints at a conflict of interest, so this case fails.
